edits.old: The lookup path is the ownership map's `GET /doa-limits` for P4 (GAP-0842; ASM-1543).
edits.new: The lookup path is the ownership map's `GET /doa-limits` for P4 (GAP-0842; ASM-1543). The regulation item is free text of up to ten characters, present on every row, checked for a repeated tuple and not against a list; the item list enters the reference data of rwb-case when Risk publishes it (GAP-0835). The field names of section 11 are fixed in the OpenAPI 3.1 document: dates as ISO 8601 dates, amounts as decimal strings of two decimals, LOV fields as their value codes and the incidentReference up to forty characters; field lengths and the difference report members are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0840). A related-party write-off answers approvalLevel L1 with reason `RELATED_PARTY` as a coded value on the answer, read from the row whose applies_when condition is the related-party one; the condition text stays in the row only, and the reason code is a value of a reference list (GAP-0839). The event rwb.access.DoaLimitChanged.v1 is published on rwb.access.events.v1 keyed on limitVersion, with limitVersion, table, change kind, validFrom, validTo and rowCount, in a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope with no personal data, through the outbox after the commit; the cache-refresh consumers confirm the payload at contract review (GAP-0841).

disposition.note: SCR-39 states added; the screen spec lacks all four, so each is Not specified in the source documents.
SCR-41 empty kept; loading, error and no access added as Not specified in the source documents, as the spec lacks them.
Load and approval use TSD P4 v3 Reference data C and A letters; the legacy Rules and parameters C letter for load is superseded.
Regulation item is free text up to ten characters, checked for repeated tuple, not against a list; item list enters rwb-case reference data later.
Field types fixed for section 11 (ISO dates, decimal strings, value codes, incidentReference up to 40); lengths and difference members left to contract review.
NOT_COVERED answered as HTTP 200 with MSG-P7-010, decision, product and incidentReference in the detail, not an error status.
